title: Practice 5: Where to: в and на

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ожидается, что небоскрёб будет погружаться в ___ (болото, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The skyscraper is expected to sink into the bog.
exercises.why: **болото → болото** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о — declines like DLI's окно: A. окно. Ending -о → -о.  Declension: sg. болото · болота · болоту · болото · болотом · болоте; pl. болота · болот · болотам · болота · болотами · болотах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Дважды нажмите на ___ (иконка, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Double-click the icon.
exercises.why: **иконка → иконку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. иконка · иконки · иконке · иконку · иконкой · иконке; pl. иконки · иконок · иконкам · иконки · иконками · иконках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Они вторглись в ___ (страна, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: They invaded the country.
exercises.why: **страна → страну** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. страна · страны · стране · страну · страной · стране; pl. страны · стран · странам · страны · странами · странах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: На ___ (такая подлость, acc. sg.) он не способен.
exercises.prompt: He is not capable of such meanness.
exercises.why: **подлость → подлость** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь — declines like DLI's часть: A. часть. Ending -ь → -ь.  **такой → такую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with подлость). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русская: A. русскую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. подлость · подлости · подлости · подлость · подлостью · подлости; pl. подлости · подлостей · подлостям · подлости · подлостями · подлостях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том пошёл в ___ (лаборатория, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom went to the lab.
exercises.why: **лаборатория → лабораторию** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ия — declines like DLI's армия: A. армию. Ending -я → -ю. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Взломщик направил своё оружие на ___ (жертва, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The burglar pointed his gun at the victim.
exercises.why: **жертва → жертву** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у. exercises.q: Телестанции вещают 24 часа в ___ (сутки, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: Television stations broadcast 24 hours a day.
exercises.why: **сутки → сутки** (acc. pl.). Plural-only, inanimate; nominative plural сутки; declines like DLI's слова (hard stem): A. слова. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. — · — · — · — · — · —; pl. сутки · суток · суткам · сутки · сутками · сутках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: На ___ (ребёнок, acc. pl.) напал рой ос.
exercises.prompt: A swarm of wasps attacked the children.
exercises.why: **ребёнок → детей** (acc. pl.). Masculine, animate; nominative plural дети; declines like DLI's книги (guttural stem): A. книги. Ending — (no ending) → -детей (the stem changes: д-).  Declension: sg. ребёнок · ребёнка · ребёнку · ребёнка · ребёнком · ребёнке; pl. дети · детей · детям · детей · детьми · детях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Приходи в ___ (любое время, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Come at any time you like.
exercises.why: **время → время** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -мя — declines like DLI's имя: A. имя. Ending -я → -я.  **любой → любое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with время). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ое → -ое.  Declension: sg. время · времени · времени · время · временем · времени; pl. времена · времён · временам · времена · временами · временах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47. exercises.q: Я положил газету на ___ (журнальный столик, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I put the newspaper on the coffee table.
exercises.why: **столик → столик** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  **журнальный → журнальный** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with столик). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ый → -ый.  Declension: sg. столик · столика · столику · столик · столиком · столике; pl. столики · столиков · столикам · столики · столиками · столиках.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я хочу плющ в ___ (свой дом, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I want ivy in my house.
exercises.why: **дом → дом** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  **свой → свой** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with дом). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой / наш. Ending -й → -й.  Declension: sg. дом · дома · дому · дом · домом · доме; pl. дома · домов · домам · дома · домами · домах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

A possessive — declines like DLI's мой / наш. Ending -е → -е.
